reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code are rare on TikTok Shop, and the pre-counted sachets fit my work trips. At $24.99 for the first box with a money-back guarantee, I would try one box.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? Magnesium is subtle, and I could take 30 sachets and still not know if it did anything.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I follow showing a real before and after on sleep or soreness, or a lower trial price.
